about.title: A student space to learn and innovate
about.p1: The Embedded Artificial Intelligence club is a university space for students passionate about AI, embedded systems and technology, learning together and turning ideas into concrete projects.
about.p2: We believe technical skill is built through practice and collaboration. That is why we run workshops, training sessions and meetups, and support students from idea to prototype.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.desc: Bringing together students interested in the field and encouraging teamwork.

pillars.title: Training
pillars.desc: Running workshops to learn the foundations of AI and embedded systems.

pillars.title: Building
pillars.desc: Developing hands-on projects that combine programming and electronics.

pillars.title: Sharing
pillars.desc: Spreading technical culture on campus and beyond through open events.

fallback.title: Outreach & Sharing
fallback.desc: Open meetups and activities to spread technical culture among students.
